title: Panettone French Toast
description: A warm and indulgent breakfast dish featuring panettone bread and melted cheddar cheese.
instructions: In a shallow dish, whisk together eggs, milk, cinnamon, and vanilla extract.
Cut the panettone into 1-inch thick slices.
Heat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat.
Dip each panettone slice into the egg mixture, coating both sides.
Place the coated panettone slices in the skillet or griddle.
Cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until golden brown.
Sprinkle shredded cheddar cheese on top of the panettone slices.
Return the skillet or griddle to the heat and cook for an additional 30 seconds, or until the cheese is melted.
